result.brief: 研究掩码扩散语言模型并行解码中已提交 token 集合的条件总相关，评估仅用边缘概率预测依赖损失的能力，并给出 logit 索引约定的校验方法。
result.reason: Analyzes conditional total correlation in masked diffusion LM parallel decoding, a continuous/latent dependency issue in diffusion language models; directly touches diffusion LM decoding and token dependency.
